name: Manase Arika
source:
A friendly and bright young girl. Arika is well-liked by all her classmates, but her best friend is Rin. She is a rather dreamy girl, with a hobby of reading shoujo manga.  Arika lost her mother when she was young, but still remember her mother's teaching of "love everyone". 
When transformed, Arika's weapon is a magical staff and she mainly fight through long-range magic
